text:
IncidentBot: PagerDuty alert — gpu_cluster_prod queue depth > 90% for 3m on pool 'prod-gpu-a'. Autoscaler unable to scale: hit global max_instances=180. Severity: P1.
Kate (oncall): ACK — I'm on it. Paging SRE.
Jamal (sre): I'm pulling up scheduler logs and placement diagnostic. Seeing a lot of small MIG slices left unused, several hosts with 1-2 small slices free but can't pack new pods due to binpack constraints.
Eli (infra): Confirmed. Pool 'prod-gpu-a' shows 35 nodes at 90-95% alloc, 22 nodes with 1-2 unalloc MIG slices each. Autoscaler reports fragmentation warnings.
Petra (ml-op): Which models are queuing? metric: prod/llm-infer-rt shows queue growth 400 -> 3k reqs in 10m. Top queues: chat-complete-v2 (40%), embed-batch (30%).
Ryan (support): Customer ALERTS queue is backed up, some customers seeing increased 503s and slow streaming starts. Support is triaging high-tier customers.
Kate (oncall): Impact timeline? need ETA for mitigation, and whether we should trigger emergency repack or eviction.
Jamal (sre): Repack and forced eviction both are options. Repack has risk of transient pod restarts; eviction of best-effort jobs will free capacity faster. Thinking: drain and repack 6 nodes with most fragmentation, and bump autoscaler max to 210 as temporary.
Eli (infra): Bumping global max requires approval from infra-leads. I can open the emergency change and push to 210 for 30m. Also have a script to convert small MIG templates to larger slices but that's slower.
Sam (eng): If we change MIG sizing dynamically it'll break pinned allocations for Dedicated customers. Avoid touching MIG templates for now.
Petra (ml-op): We can try quick mitigations: 1) evict non-critical batch jobs (embed-batch low priority) 2) enable soft placement override to allow cross-node packing of small-slice pods (risk: slightly higher latency).
Kate (oncall): Action plan: (A) Evict low-priority batch queues now. (B) Increase autoscaler cap to 210 for 30m. (C) Start repack on top 6 fragmented nodes with rolling window. (D) Notify customers.
IncidentBot: OpsPager invoked: Escalation to infra-leads and on-call.
Ryan (support): I'll send outage advisory to affected customers: "We are actively mitigating GPU capacity; you may observe increased latency and throttling."
Jamal (sre): Running diagnostics: kubectl logs -n infra autoscaler-ctrl | tail -n 200 shows: 
```
WARN: placement_failed: insufficient contiguous MIG slices
WARN: autoscaler: hit_global_max_instances=180
ERROR: binpack: cannot fit pod model=chat-large required_slices=2 available_slots=1
```
Jamal (sre): Also running rictl placement-explain --pod chat-large@prod shows fragmentation map.
Eli (infra): Kicking off eviction script: infra/evict-lowpri.sh --pool prod-gpu-a --label batch=true --grace 30s. Starting now.
Sam (eng): Noting side effect: some long-running eval jobs will restart. Monitoring for regressions.
Petra (ml-op): After eviction started, queue depth delta shows small drop from 3k -> 2.5k in 3m. Good.
Kate (oncall): Eli, please request autoscaler cap bump. Jamal, schedule repack order: which nodes first?
Eli (infra): Raised emergency change: change request #E-4321. Applying temporary max_instances=210 now.
IncidentBot: Change applied: autoscaler.max_instances updated to 210 by Eli.
Jamal (sre): Starting repack plan: reorder nodes by fragmentation score, drain node gpu-node-47, gpu-node-102, gpu-node-210, then run repack agent to live migrate small pods where possible. Rolling windows 60s.
Kate (oncall): Coordinate with support for customer comms. Keep me updated every 5 min.
Ryan (support): Sent message to affected customers and opened support tickets for top 5 paying customers. No confirmed data leakage, only latency and throttling.
Petra (ml-op): Observability: token per sec limiter shows throttles dropping by 20% post-eviction. Error budget alert still firing but trending down.
Sam (eng): Noticed a single host gpu-node-210 still has 2 free small MIG slices but scheduler won't pack due to nodeSelector mismatch. Adjusting deployment tolerations to allow placement.
Jamal (sre): Made toleration change in deployment chat-large to allow pack onto mixed-slice hosts. Watch for perf regressions.
Eli (infra): Repack progress: 4/6 nodes drained, repack agent migrating ~120 pods. No unexpected OOMs.
IncidentBot: Metric update: queue depth now 1200, autoscaler added 20 instances after cap bump.
Kate (oncall): Good. Once queue depth < 500 and 95th latency < 700ms for 10m we declare mitigation. Keep repack running until fragmentation <= 10%.
Petra (ml-op): Noting risk: repeated autoscaler cap bumps mask root cause — we should schedule a follow-up to improve binpack heuristics and consider a new MIG mixing policy.
Sam (eng): Agreed. I logged ENG-1289 to investigate scheduler affinity and packing algorithm.
Jamal (sre): Monitoring for regressions. If queue starts growing again, next step is emergency reconfiguration of MIG templates (requires customer notice).
Ryan (support): Customer update sent: "We have mitigations in place; restoration expected within 45 minutes. We'll follow up with post-incident notes"
Kate (oncall): Current status: mitigations applied, impact reduced but not fully resolved. Keeping P1 active. Will update incident channel in 10 min. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
